shortDescription: Cheelee (CHEEL) is scheduled to unlock about 6.42 million tokens at 8:00 AM on October 3, according to Web3 asset data platform RootData's token unlock data. According to ChainCatcher, the unlocked tokens are valued at about $2.15 million.
